spec.description:
ProctorGeo D-Rain HC (HC9 / HC10) is a flexible,
lightweight horizontal and vertical cavity drainage and acoustic separation mat.
Manufactured with a three-dimensional, high-void entangled monofilament
polypropylene core thermally bonded to a permeable non-woven geotextile filter
fabric on one or both sides, it creates a permanent drainage and ventilation
plane under standing seam metal roofs, zinc claddings, and below-ground
structures. It relieves hydrostatic pressure, rapidly channels away incidental
moisture, and provides significant acoustic damping against rain noise
drumming.
features:
Three-dimensional entangled polypropylene
monofilament core with high void ratio

Thermally bonded non-woven geotextile
filter fabric prevents fines and dirt clogging

Dampens rain impact noise on
zinc, copper, and standing seam metal roofs by up to 21 dB

Maintains an
uninterrupted drainage and ventilation cavity behind claddings and beneath
roofs

High compressive strength resisting construction traffic and cladding
fastener loads

Resistant to chemical attack, rot, mildew, and soil
microorganisms

Flexible and lightweight for fast unrolling over plywood
substrates and membranes

Relieves hydrostatic pressure in horizontal plaza
decks and vertical retaining walls

technical.value:
High hydraulic transmissivity (approx. 1.2 - 2.5 l/m·s at
hydraulic gradient 1.0)

Up to 21 dB sound reduction under metal roof

fire hazard properties; polymer core does not contribute significantly to fire

spec.compliance:
EN ISO 12958, EN ISO 25619-2,
AS/NZS 4200.2 drainage cavity compliance, NCC 2022 condensation management

100% recyclable polypropylene; chemically inert; non-toxic;
zero ODP
install:
Install primary roof underlay or waterproofing membrane
over plywood substrate or structural deck

Unroll ProctorGeo HC horizontally
or vertically with geotextile filter fabric facing upward/outward

Overlap the
integrated geotextile filter flap by a minimum of 100mm over adjacent runs to
prevent fines entering the core

Fix temporarily in place with staples or
clout nails along top edges or outside the active drainage zone

Install
standing seam metal roof pans, zinc cladding, or pavers directly over the
drainage mat

Fasten metal cladding clips directly through the mat into the
timber substrate as specified by cladding manufacturer

Ensure the lower edge
discharges freely into roof gutters, drainage sumps, or perimeter weep holes
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof or facade cladding requires an entangled
monofilament drainage and acoustic mat (standing seam metal, zinc, copper)
Verify compatibility with primary water-resistive barrier or roof underlay
Check required acoustic rain noise damping (up to 21 dB reduction)

Calculate
total square meterage including 100mm filter fabric overlap allowance

Ensure
free drainage discharge pathway at eaves and footings
limitations:
Not a primary waterproofing
membrane; must be used in conjunction with a compliant underlay or waterproofing
layer

Do not leave exposed to direct outdoor UV weather for longer than 30
days prior to cladding

Fasteners must not pinch or compress the drainage
pathway excessively

retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorGeo HC (D-Rain HC9 / HC10) is an entangled monofilament
polypropylene drainage and acoustic separation mat laminated with a non-woven
geotextile filter fabric. Sized at 9mm to 10mm thickness in roll format, it
creates a permanent drainage and ventilation plane under standing seam metal,
zinc, and copper roofs, as well as behind wall claddings and beneath plaza
pavers. Delivering up to 21 dB in rain noise damping while rapidly draining
condensation, it protects metal claddings from underside corrosion and water
ponding.
